selected-preferential-base.why: Activity false skips the Schedule D boundary answers. The sibling conjunct then requires schedule-d-required.conclusion = no, so a required Schedule D with no recorded sale makes the guard false.

schedule3-line1-direct-ftc.why: The scope answers are read only when foreign-tax box 7 is above zero. With no foreign tax the credit does not apply, and a blocked box 7 family blocks the guard instead of turning it false.

ss-benefits-worksheet.why: The benefits-scope answers are read only when net benefits are above zero, and the lived-apart answer only when filing status is married filing separately. Neither is open on a return the worksheet does not apply to.

form1040-line6d.why: The lived-apart answer is read when filing status is married filing separately. Any other status makes the line inapplicable; the answer is not open.

form1040-line12d-spouse-age.why: The spouse age and separate-return answers sit under a filing-status choose whose other branch is inapplicable. The set condition is constantly true, so an applicable branch reads the answer.

form1040-line12d-spouse-age-not-checked.why: Same filing-status gate as the spouse age box.

form1040-line12d-spouse-blind.why: Same filing-status gate as the spouse age box.

form1040-line12d-spouse-blind-not-checke.why: Same filing-status gate as the spouse age box.

form1040-line2a.why: The box 8 subtotal set has a constantly true condition, so the guard reads it whenever the line is attempted.

capital-loss-carryover.short-term.why: The prior-return set has a constantly true condition. An open carryover answer blocks; it does not make the guard false.

capital-loss-carryover.long-term.why: Same constantly true set as the short-term carryover.

schedule-d-required.conclusion.why: The Exception 1 set has a constantly true condition, so an open Exception 1 answer blocks the conclusion instead of publishing it.

form1040-line12e.why: The Schedule A total is read whenever the guard is attempted. The guard itself cannot be a silent false.

dtb-child.tie-breaker-clear.why: Its sets do not give the guard a false result. An open tie-breaker answer blocks.

schedule-a-line16.why: The gambling-loss set does not give the guard a false result.

form1040-line12d-you-age.why: The age answer is under a constantly true set.

form1040-line12d-you-age-not-checked.why: The age answer is under a constantly true set.

form1040-line12d-you-blind.why: The blindness answer is under a constantly true set.
